highlighter-lime.$description: Highlighter Lime — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

onyx-black.$description: Onyx Black — Page canvas, table row backgrounds, elevated card surfaces — the base layer everything else floats on

zinc-hairline.$description: Zinc Hairline — Borders, dividers, table cell separators, card outlines — the most-used border color, barely visible against the canvas, defining structure without weight

carbon.$description: Carbon — Button hover/active surfaces, secondary card backgrounds — one step above canvas for subtle elevation

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary text, icon strokes, logo fills, filled-chip text — the default foreground for the entire interface

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Secondary/muted text, inactive nav items, table metadata, helper labels

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Tertiary text, disabled controls, low-emphasis metadata

smoke.$description: Smoke — Heavier borders, input field outlines — for elements that need more definition than the standard hairline

geist-mono.$description: Primary UI typeface — all body text, table data, buttons, inputs, navigation, prices, and metadata. The monospace choice gives the marketplace a terminal/trading-desk identity, aligning numerical data in tables and reinforcing a developer/collector audience.

tomorrow.$description: Display and section headings — section labels like 'Trending', 'Cards', 'Trusted by', and 'News'. A clean sans-serif contrast to the monospace body, giving headlines a slightly softer, more editorial voice while staying within the technical character.
